Package org.lucas.util

Interface ObjectBase

All Known Implementing Classes:
Appointment, Billing, Doctor, MedicalCertificate, Patient, Prescription, Session, User
public interface ObjectBase
Provides a base interface for all objects in the system requiring standardized methods for equality checks, JSON serialization, and content printing. This interface ensures consistency across different objects, especially for operations involving comparisons and debug output.

    • equals

      boolean equals(Object obj)
      Determines whether some other object is "equal to" this one. Implementing classes must override this method to define equality based on their specific state.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      obj - the reference object with which to compare.
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the obj argument; false otherwise.
